summary.title: Intel® Resource Director Technology (Intel® RDT) Architecture Specification
summary.one_liner: Intel RDT architecture specification: the official document defining the Intel RDT feature set, which the listing says covers classes of service, cache masks, and bandwidth allocation and monitoring IDs.
takeaways: The page is the landing page for Intel's RDT architecture specification document.
The document defines the architecture of the Intel RDT feature set.
The page text itself contains no preview; the content must be viewed or downloaded from the site.
The listing says the spec covers classes of service, cache masks, and bandwidth allocation and monitoring IDs.
summary.summary: This Intel page is a record for the Intel Resource Director Technology (Intel RDT) Architecture Specification. The page text gives only a one-line description saying the document defines the architecture of the Intel RDT feature set, and states that no preview is available so the material must be viewed or downloaded. The rest of the page is cookie consent text with no technical content. According to the listing, the specification covers classes of service, cache masks, and bandwidth allocation and monitoring IDs as exposed by resctrl.
